notes.title: Some news about the english version !
notes.notes:
Hello gamers ! 

We just want to let you know that the english translation of the game is now finished. We've get all the administration papers we needed too ! We are currently just doing a last run on the game to see if really everything is working fine and we will prepare the game for the Steam launch. 

If there is no problem in the next days, we hope that in one or two weeks we will be able to tell you a launch date for the game in it's english version ! ;)

Best regards to all and don't forget to spread the word and play a lot ! =D

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25101422/089f6fbcc13e4b798d02f0534c26938fd4a6ce15.png
